svg.title: Interface agents and RO-Crates for an automated biomanufacturing DBTL pipeline
svg.desc: The four DBTL stages of the SYNBIOCHEM pipeline for microbial production of fine chemicals (Carbonell et al., Communications Biology 2018), with four proposed interface agents that package a shared store of four RO-Crates, a coordinator, and a human researcher who seeds the crates and approves each round.
svg.text: Interface agents and RO-Crates for an automated biomanufacturing DBTL pipeline
